📬 No home channel is set for Line. A home channel is where Hermes delivers cron job results and cross-platform messages.

Type /sethome to make this chat your home channel, or ignore to skip.

ℹ Codex gpt-5.3-codex-spark caps context at 128K, so auto-compaction was raised to 70% (from 50%) to use more of the window before summarizing.
  Opt back out: hermes config set compression.codex_gpt55_autoraise false
